lines.en: Move slowly, soul of the flesh

lines.zh: 一条腿拖着走，摩擦着碎石。
lines.en: One leg drags, scraping the gravel.

lines.zh: 我绕过倒塌的墙，才敢过街。
lines.en: I round the fallen wall before crossing.
Staring at player, ready to act
My neck hangs crooked. Not broken yet.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，眼却没离开。
lines.en: My head tilts, but my eyes never leave.
My eyes roll white and only you remain.

lines.zh: 我的手腕转不动，脸却朝你。
lines.en: My wrist will not turn, but my face comes to you.
Staring at player, ready to bite

lines.zh: 我的手伸过来，是它自己动的。
lines.en: My hand reaches for you on its own.

lines.zh: 我需要一个温暖的尸体...
我伸出残舌舔了舔空气。
lines.en: I lick the air with what is left of my tongue.

lines.zh: 别走开，我还想再咬一口！
lines.en: Don't go, I want another bite!
Your blood is sweet, come closer!

lines.zh: 你闻起来很像...我的同类！

lines.en: Get out of my way, or you'll regret it!
My bones are hard, toughen up!

lines.zh: 你踩着我的脚，我慢了半拍。
lines.en: You step on my foot and I slow half a beat.
You shove me and my skin slides loose.
Make way; the brick heap will not stop me.

lines.zh: 我的指甲翻起来了，照样抓。
lines.en: My nail peeled back and I still claw.

lines.zh: 你撞开了我半边的下巴。
lines.en: You knock half my jaw loose.

lines.zh: 我在废墟里撞翻一只铁桶。
lines.en: I knock over a tin bucket in the rubble.
Don't block my path, I'm hungry!

lines.zh: 给我让路，否则后果自负！
lines.en: Make way, or face the consequences!

lines.zh: 我们需要繁殖...为了末世！
lines.en: We need to reproduce... for the end!

lines.zh: 我闻到别的行尸就在附近。
求偶季节到了...让我们繁衍！

lines.en: Don't touch this rotting bone with your hands.

lines.zh: 找到你了，你的末日来了。
lines.en: Found you, your end is here.
Decay is the only way out.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块布，缠住断腿。
lines.en: I pick up a rag and bind my broken leg.
Seeking the taste of the living.
Three streets later, I'm still here.
One bite and you join us.
Taste the fear of the living.

lines.zh: 血腥味比你的脚步先到我这里。
lines.en: The smell of blood reaches me before your steps.

lines.zh: 废墟里的活人，只有你一个。
lines.en: In these ruins, you are the only living one.

lines.zh: 你被我咬过，就别想好了。
lines.en: Once I bite you, there is no healing.

lines.zh: 我的皮掉了一半，还站得住。
lines.en: Half my skin is gone, yet I still stand.

lines.zh: 这条街，我走过很多回了。
lines.en: I have walked this street many times.

lines.zh: 我数着你身后的那扇门。
lines.en: I count the door behind you.

lines.zh: 你的枪只剩几发，我记得。
lines.en: You have only a few rounds left; I remember.
Breath of the living, my prey.
Living blood, I will take it.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚步乱一次。
lines.en: I wait for your steps to break rhythm once.

lines.zh: 你跑，是因为还没被咬到。
lines.en: You run because you have not been bitten yet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地挪，让恐惧先长。
lines.en: I shuffle slowly so your fear grows.
Broken windows and walls are my roads.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的喉咙，那里最暖。
lines.en: I watch your throat; it is warmest there.

lines.zh: 你开枪也没用，我不怕疼。
lines.en: Shoot if you like; I do not fear pain.

lines.zh: 尸变的名单上，我在前面。
lines.en: On the turn list, I am early.
I only wait for you to tire.

lines.zh: 你退到死胡同了，我闻得到。
lines.en: You backed into a dead end; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的背包带往回拽。
lines.en: I grab your pack straps and haul you back.
No use hiding — turning can't be undone.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬进你护腕的皮扣。
lines.en: My teeth close on the strap of your bracer.

lines.zh: 腐败的指甲刮开你的胳膊。
lines.en: Rotten nails rake open your arm.
My teeth are caught in your leggings.

lines.zh: 残肢抡过来，砸你的侧脸。
lines.en: My ruined limb swings into your cheek.
One bite and you will turn.
I press you against the broken wall.

lines.zh: 撕裂伤会一直流血不止。

lines.en: A new walker joins the horde.

lines.zh: 夜晚的猎物已准备就绪！
腐烂的血液中诞生新生命！
新的行尸从黑暗中出现！
新的行尸在夜幕下诞生！
lines.en: New walkers are born at night.

lines.zh: 废墟底下，一具尸体动了。
lines.en: Under the rubble, a corpse stirs.

lines.zh: 街口的风，带来了第一声低吼。
lines.en: The corner wind brings the first low groan.

lines.zh: 我从瓦砾里撑起上半身。
lines.en: I push my upper body out of the rubble.
In this end, the dead outnumber the living.

lines.zh: 墙后面的脚步，从慢变快。
lines.en: Behind the wall, steps go from slow to fast.
The fire burned away half my face.
The blast threw me into the broken bricks.

lines.zh: 箭插在肋骨间，我不去拔。
lines.en: The arrow sits between my ribs; I leave it there.

lines.zh: 雷劈下时，我正扶着一根电线杆。
lines.en: The bolt came as I leaned on a power pole.
